> (3) TUTTO il codice, file per file, riga per riga — per leggerlo tutto in un unico posto
> e per usarlo come BACKUP.

---

## PARTE 1 — Come funziona il sistema (tutorial in parole semplici)

### L'idea
DreamAnimatore è uno studio di animazione per creare **serie video animate in stile Pixar** ottimizzate per i social.
Un episodio NON è un unico video generato tutto insieme (nessuna AI oggi può produrre 5 minuti di video in un colpo solo):
è una **sequenza di inquadrature** (clip di 6–15 secondi) che il player dell'app unisce in un episodio unico,
con voce fuori campo e sottotitoli.

### I mattoni dell'app (come le stanze di una casa)
- **Pagine** (`src/pages`): le "stanze" che vedi sullo schermo.
  - `Home.jsx` — elenco delle serie, creazione nuova serie, dashboard crediti, chiave Google.
  - `ProjectDetail.jsx` — una serie: cast, episodi, pulsanti di produzione.
  - `EpisodeDetail.jsx` — un episodio: le sue inquadrature con i pulsanti Genera / Gratis / Importa, player e pacchetto social.
- **Componenti** (`src/components`): i "mobili" dentro le stanze, riusabili (card, player, pannelli, pulsanti).
  Quelli in `src/components/ui` sono la libreria grafica standard (shadcn/ui), non modificata dall'app.
- **Entità** (`base44/entities`): il "database". Definiscono QUALI DATI si salvano:
  - `Project` — la serie (titolo, idea, formato, qualità, durata episodi...).
  - `Character` — i personaggi del cast, con immagine di riferimento.
  - `Episode` — l'episodio (trama, logline, titolo social...).
  - `Shot` — la singola inquadratura (prompt video, testo del narratore, durata, stato, costi, clip, media importati).
- **Funzioni backend** (`base44/functions`): il "cervello" lato server che usa l'AI:
  scrivono cast, episodi e prompt video, inviano le clip al servizio di generazione, stimano i costi.
- **Codice condiviso backend** (`base44/shared`): helper usati da più funzioni.

### Il flusso di produzione (come si usa l'app)
1. **Nuova serie** — dalla Home: titolo, idea/brief, genere, pubblico, formato (verticale 9:16 o cinema 16:9),
   qualità (veloce o alta), durata target e numero di episodi.
2. **Cast** — in ProjectDetail, "Genera cast e stile": l'AI crea 2–4 personaggi originali con immagine di riferimento.
   Le immagini di riferimento servono a mantenere i personaggi identici in ogni scena.
3. **Episodio** — "Nuovo episodio": l'AI scrive titolo, trama, scene e inquadrature divise per arrivare alla durata
   richiesta (es. 5 minuti), e per ogni inquadratura il testo del narratore.
4. **Produzione** — in EpisodeDetail le inquadrature si producono IN ORDINE (la numero 2 si sblocca solo quando
   la numero 1 è pronta). Per ogni inquadratura hai TRE strade:
   - **Gratis** (pulsante "Gratis"): crea la scena animando NEL BROWSER l'immagine del personaggio presente
     nella scena (zoom, panoramica, movimento lento, ruotati automaticamente per dare ritmo) con voce fuori
     campo del browser. **Zero crediti.**
   - **Genera** (AI): manda il prompt video al servizio AI (modello economico seedance) e ottiene una vera clip.
     **Consuma crediti**: prima vedi la stima ("Stima crediti"), poi il costo reale salvato sull'inquadratura.
   - **Importa** (pulsante "Importa"): carica dal TUO dispositivo una clip video, un'immagine o un audio.
     - la **clip video** va nell'episodio al posto della clip AI (l'inquadratura risulta subito pronta);
     - l'**immagine** viene animata nel browser come una scena gratuita (zoom, pan, deriva);
     - l'**audio** (voce registrata, musica, effetti) sostituisce la voce fuori campo sintetica quando guardi l'episodio.
     **Zero crediti.** I file restano PRIVATI nel tuo spazio: l'app genera al volo un link temporaneo sicuro solo per guardarli.
5. **Riproduzione** — "Guarda l'episodio": il player unisce tutte le inquadrature pronte (clip AI, scene gratuite
   e clip importate insieme) con voce fuori campo (del browser, o l'audio importato) e sottotitoli.
6. **Pubblicazione** — "Pacchetto social": titolo, descrizione e hashtag pronti per pubblicare sui social.

### I crediti: come non sprecarli
- Ogni generazione AI consuma i "crediti integrazione" del piano. Il VIDEO è la voce più costosa; le immagini del cast costano pochissimo.
- Prima di generare: pulsante "Stima crediti" → costo indicativo delle inquadrature mancanti (non addebitato).
- Dopo ogni clip: il costo reale è salvato sull'inquadratura e sommato per episodio (visibile nelle card).
- Strategia consigliata: scene "parlate" dal narratore in modalità Gratis o con audio importato; le scene
  d'azione chiave in AI; montaggi fatti fuori dall'app importati come clip.
- Nella Home, il CreditsPanel mostra consumato / in sospeso / disponibile e il reset mensile.

### Chiave Google AI (facoltativa)
Con GoogleKeyBox (nella Home) puoi inserire una tua chiave di Google AI Studio: viene verificata dalla funzione
`verifyGoogleKey` e salvata nel tuo profilo utente. La chiave NON è scritta nel codice dell'app.

### Ordine e blocco sequenziale (regole d'oro)
- Dentro l'episodio: ogni inquadratura si sblocca quando la precedente è "ready".
- Tra gli episodi: l'episodio N non si produce finché l'episodio N-1 non ha TUTTE le inquadrature "ready".
- Una scena "Gratis" o una **clip importata** conta come pronta: sblocca la successiva e, a episodio completo, l'episodio dopo.


### Cosa contiene ogni cartella
- radice — configurazione del progetto (build, stili, lint, entry HTML) e questo documento.
- `src/api` — client Base44 già inizializzato: è il "telefono" tra interfaccia e database/server.
- `src/lib` — utilità trasversali: contesto di login, client react-query, funzione `cn`, pagina 404, firma dei file privati.
- `src/utils` — helper generici (es. `createPageUrl`).
- `src/hooks` — logica riusabile: la coda di generazione delle inquadrature (`useShotGeneration`) e helper responsive.
- `src/components` — componenti comuni (protezione pagine, layout login, icona Google).
- `src/components/studio` — il cuore dell'app: cast, crediti, episodi, player, scene gratuite, importazione media, chiave Google, nuova serie, card, inquadrature, social.
- `src/components/ui` — libreria grafica standard shadcn/ui (Button, Dialog, Input, ...): NON modificata, elenco nella Parte 3.
- `src/pages` — le pagine vere e proprie (Home, dettagli serie ed episodio, login/registrazione/recupero password).
- `base44/entities` — gli schemi del database (Project, Character, Episode, Shot).
- `base44/functions` — le funzioni server (una cartella per funzione, sempre `entry.ts`).
- `base44/shared` — helper condivisi tra le funzioni server.

---

#### `vite.config.js`

*configurazione del builder Vite*

````
import base44 from "@base44/vite-plugin"
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

// https://vite.dev/config/
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    base44({
      // Support for legacy code that imports the base44 SDK with @/integrations, @/entities, etc.
      // can be removed if the code has been updated to use the new SDK imports from @base44/sdk
      legacySDKImports: process.env.BASE44_LEGACY_SDK_IMPORTS === 'true',
      hmrNotifier: true,
      navigationNotifier: true,
      analyticsTracker: true,
      visualEditAgent: true
    }),
    react(),
  ]
});

````

#### `eslint.config.js`

*regole di qualità del codice*

````
import globals from "globals";
import pluginJs from "@eslint/js";
````

#### `README.md`

*presentazione del progetto*

````
# Base44 Project

Use this repository to run and edit the app locally, then publish changes back through Base44.

Any change pushed to the repo will also be reflected in the Base44 Builder.

## Prerequisites

1. Clone the repository using the project's Git URL.
2. Navigate to the project directory.
3. Install dependencies: `npm install`.
4. Install the Base44 CLI: `npm install -g base44@latest`.
5. Install [Deno](https://docs.deno.com/runtime/getting_started/installation/) — the local Base44 backend runs on it.

Run `base44 --help` (or see the [CLI reference](https://docs.base44.com/developers/references/cli/commands/introduction)) for the full command surface.

## Run Locally

Three commands, from the project root:

```bash
base44 login   # one-time per machine
base44 link    # one-time per clone
base44 dev     # local backend + frontend together
```

Open the frontend URL that `base44 dev` prints (typically `http://localhost:5173`).

Notes:

- **Every fresh clone needs `base44 link`.** It writes `base44/.app.jsonc` (the app-id pointer), which is deliberately gitignored. Your app id is in the Builder URL (`app.base44.com/apps/<id>/...`); `base44 link --help` shows the non-interactive flags.
- **`base44 dev` runs the frontend for you** (via `site.serveCommand` in this repo's `base44/config.jsonc`) — never run `npm run dev` yourself: alone it serves a UI with no backend behind it (`[base44] Proxy not enabled`, every `/api` call fails), and alongside `base44 dev` the second Vite silently takes the next port and you end up looking at the wrong one.
- **The app must be published at least once for the UI to load under `base44 dev`.** The frontend boots by fetching app settings from the hosted app; before the first publish that fails and every page redirects to login. The local API works regardless.
- Entities, functions, and auth run locally — entity data is **in-memory only**, wiped when `base44 dev` restarts. Everything else (Core integrations, OAuth login) is forwarded to your deployed app. Full breakdown: [Local development overview](https://docs.base44.com/developers/backend/overview/local-dev/local-development-overview).

## Frontend Only, Hosted Backend

To work on just the frontend against your app's live hosted backend:

```bash
base44 dev --remote
```

⚠️ In this mode writes go to your app's **production data** — plain `base44 dev` keeps everything local.

## Publish Your Changes

After pushing your changes to git, open the Base44 dashboard and publish the app:

```bash
base44 dashboard open
```

This repo syncs to Base44 through git, so publish from the dashboard rather than `base44 deploy` — a CLI deploy ships your local tree directly, bypassing the sync, and the deployed state silently diverges from the repo.

## Docs & Support

GitHub integration: [https://docs.base44.com/developers/app-code/local-development/github](https://docs.base44.com/developers/app-code/local-development/github)

Local development: [https://docs.base44.com/developers/backend/overview/local-dev/local-development-overview](https://docs.base44.com/developers/backend/overview/local-dev/local-development-overview)

Support: [https://app.base44.com/support](https://app.base44.com/support)

````

#### `src/App.jsx`

*il router: definisce le pagine e protegge quelle riservate agli utenti registrati*

````
import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/toaster"
import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { queryClientInstance } from '@/lib/query-client'
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Navigate, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import PageNotFound from './lib/PageNotFound';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import UserNotRegisteredError from '@/components/UserNotRegisteredError';
import ProtectedRoute from '@/components/ProtectedRoute';
import ScrollToTop from './components/ScrollToTop';
// Add page imports here
import Home from './pages/Home';
import ProjectDetail from './pages/ProjectDetail';
import EpisodeDetail from './pages/EpisodeDetail';
import Login from './pages/Login';
import Register from './pages/Register';
import ForgotPassword from './pages/ForgotPassword';
import ResetPassword from './pages/ResetPassword';

const AuthenticatedApp = () => {
  const { isLoadingAuth, isLoadingPublicSettings, authError, navigateToLogin } = useAuth();

  // Show loading spinner while checking app public settings or auth
  if (isLoadingPublicSettings || isLoadingAuth) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-slate-200 border-t-slate-800 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Handle authentication errors
  if (authError) {
    if (authError.type === 'user_not_registered') {
      return <UserNotRegisteredError />;
    } else if (authError.type === 'auth_required') {
      // Redirect to login automatically
      navigateToLogin();
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Render the main app
  return (
    <Routes>
      {/* Add your page Route elements here */}
      <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
      <Route path="/register" element={<Register />} />
      <Route path="/forgot-password" element={<ForgotPassword />} />
      <Route path="/reset-password" element={<ResetPassword />} />
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute unauthenticatedElement={<Navigate to="/login" replace />} />}>
        <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
        <Route path="/progetto/:id" element={<ProjectDetail />} />
        <Route path="/episodio/:id" element={<EpisodeDetail />} />
      </Route>
      <Route path="*" element={<PageNotFound />} />
    </Routes>
  );
};


function App() {

  return (
    <AuthProvider>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClientInstance}>
        <Router>
          <ScrollToTop />
          <AuthenticatedApp />
        </Router>
        <Toaster />
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </AuthProvider>
  )
}

export default App
````

#### `src/lib/AuthContext.jsx`

*gestisce lo stato di login per tutta l'app*

````
import React, { createContext, useState, useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { appParams } from '@/lib/app-params';

const AuthContext = createContext();

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
  const [isLoadingAuth, setIsLoadingAuth] = useState(true);
  const [isLoadingPublicSettings, setIsLoadingPublicSettings] = useState(true);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState(null);
  const [authChecked, setAuthChecked] = useState(false);
  const [appPublicSettings, setAppPublicSettings] = useState(null); // Contains only { id, public_settings }

  useEffect(() => {
    checkAppState();
  }, []);

  const checkAppState = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoadingPublicSettings(true);
      setAuthError(null);
      
      try {
        const publicSettings = await base44.app.getPublicSettings();
        setAppPublicSettings(publicSettings);
        
        // If we got the app public settings successfully, check if user is authenticated
        if (appParams.token) {
          await checkUserAuth();
        } else {
          setIsLoadingAuth(false);
          setIsAuthenticated(false);
          setAuthChecked(true);
        }
        setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
      } catch (appError) {
        console.error('App state check failed:', appError);
        
        // Handle app-level errors
        if (appError.status === 403 && appError.data?.extra_data?.reason) {
          const reason = appError.data.extra_data.reason;
          if (reason === 'auth_required') {
            setAuthError({
              type: 'auth_required',
              message: 'Authentication required'
            });
          } else if (reason === 'user_not_registered') {
            setAuthError({
              type: 'user_not_registered',
              message: 'User not registered for this app'
            });
          } else {
            setAuthError({
              type: reason,
              message: appError.message
            });
          }
        } else {
          setAuthError({
            type: 'unknown',
            message: appError.message || 'Failed to load app'
          });
        }
        setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
        setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Unexpected error:', error);
      setAuthError({
        type: 'unknown',
        message: error.message || 'An unexpected error occurred'
      });
      setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
    }
  };

  const checkUserAuth = async () => {
    try {
      // Now check if the user is authenticated
      setIsLoadingAuth(true);
      const currentUser = await base44.auth.me();
      setUser(currentUser);
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      setAuthChecked(true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('User auth check failed:', error);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
      setAuthChecked(true);
      
      // If user auth fails, it might be an expired token
      if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403) {
        setAuthError({
          type: 'auth_required',
          message: 'Authentication required'
        });
      }
    }
  };

  const logout = (shouldRedirect = true) => {
    setUser(null);
    setIsAuthenticated(false);
    
    if (shouldRedirect) {
      // Use the SDK's logout method which handles token cleanup and redirect
      base44.auth.logout(window.location.href);
    } else {
      // Just remove the token without redirect
      base44.auth.logout();
    }
  };

  const navigateToLogin = () => {
    // Use the SDK's redirectToLogin method
    base44.auth.redirectToLogin(window.location.href);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ 
      user, 
      isAuthenticated, 
      isLoadingAuth,
      isLoadingPublicSettings,
      authError,
      appPublicSettings,
      authChecked,
      logout,
      navigateToLogin,
      checkUserAuth,
      checkAppState
    }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

````

#### `src/lib/app-params.js`

*lettura dei parametri di configurazione dell'app*

````
import { getAccessToken } from '@base44/sdk';

const isNode = typeof window === 'undefined';

const isClearAccessTokenRequested = () =>
	!isNode && new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("clear_access_token") === 'true';

const clearStoredAccessToken = () => {
	window.localStorage.removeItem('base44_access_token');
	window.localStorage.removeItem('token');
}

const getAppParams = () => {
	if (isClearAccessTokenRequested()) {
		clearStoredAccessToken();
	}
	return {
		appId: import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_APP_ID,
		token: getAccessToken(),
		functionsVersion: (!isNode && new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("functions_version")?.trim()) || import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_FUNCTIONS_VERSION,
		appBaseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL,
	}
}


export const appParams = {
	...getAppParams()
}

````

#### `src/lib/authReturnTo.js`

*decide la destinazione dopo il login*

````
// Shared by the auth pages (Login, Register, and any page that resumes a flow
// after sign-in, e.g. the MCP OAuth consent page). Keep the redirect
// validation in one place — it is security-sensitive and easy to drift.

// Resolve ?returnTo= to a safe same-origin path, else "/".
//
// The same-origin check alone is not enough: a value like /.//evil.com or
// /\evil.com parses same-origin but normalizes to a protocol-relative
// //evil.com when assigned to location.href — an open redirect. So require the
// resolved path to be exactly one leading slash (no "//" prefix, no backslash).
export function safeReturnTo() {
  const raw = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("returnTo");
  if (!raw) return "/";
  try {
    const url = new URL(raw, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return "/";
    // Only access_token/clear_access_token are still URL-read by app-params.js, but the
    // whole bootstrap set stays stripped: one going back to a URL read must not silently
    // become injectable again. Normal app-flow params (e.g. the OAuth consent ctx) are kept.
    for (const p of ["access_token", "clear_access_token", "app_id", "app_base_url", "functions_version", "from_url"]) {
      url.searchParams.delete(p);
    }
    const path = url.pathname + url.search;
    if (!path.startsWith("/") || path.startsWith("//") || path.includes("\\")) return "/";
    return path;
  } catch {
    return "/";
  }
}

````

#### `src/lib/PageNotFound.jsx`

*pagina 404*

````
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';


export default function PageNotFound({}) {
    const location = useLocation();
    const pageName = location.pathname.substring(1);

    const { data: authData, isFetched } = useQuery({
        queryKey: ['user'],
        queryFn: async () => {
            try {
                const user = await base44.auth.me();
                return { user, isAuthenticated: true };
            } catch (error) {
                return { user: null, isAuthenticated: false };
            }
        }
    });
    
    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-slate-50">
            <div className="max-w-md w-full">
                <div className="text-center space-y-6">
                    {/* 404 Error Code */}
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                        <h1 className="text-7xl font-light text-slate-300">404</h1>
                        <div className="h-0.5 w-16 bg-slate-200 mx-auto"></div>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Main Message */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                        <h2 className="text-2xl font-medium text-slate-800">
                            Page Not Found
                        </h2>
                        <p className="text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                            The page <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">"{pageName}"</span> could not be found in this application.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Admin Note */}
                    {isFetched && authData.isAuthenticated && authData.user?.role === 'admin' && (
                        <div className="mt-8 p-4 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                            <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
                                <div className="flex-shrink-0 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-orange-100 flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5">
                                    <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-400"></div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="text-left space-y-1">
                                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Admin Note</p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                                        This could mean that the AI hasn't implemented this page yet. Ask it to implement it in the chat.
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}
                    
                    {/* Action Button */}
                    <div className="pt-6">
                        <button 
                            onClick={() => window.location.href = '/'} 
                            className="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-slate-500"
                        >
                            <svg className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M3 12l2-2m0 0l7-7 7 7M5 10v10a1 1 0 001 1h3m10-11l2 2m-2-2v10a1 1 0 01-1 1h-3m-6 0a1 1 0 001-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v4a1 1 0 001 1m-6 0h6" />
                            </svg>
                            Go Home
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
````

#### `src/lib/shotMedia.js`

*firma i file privati importati (video, immagine, audio) e restituisce i link temporanei sicuri per riprodurli*

````
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";

const signUri = async (fileUri) => {
  try {
    const { signed_url } = await base44.integrations.Core.CreateFileSignedUrl({
      file_uri: fileUri,
      expires_in: 3600,
    });
    return signed_url || null;
  } catch (err) {
    return null;
  }
};

// Resolves the playable media of a shot: AI clip / imported private clip,
// free-mode image / imported private image, imported narration audio.
export async function resolveShotMedia(shot) {
  const empty = { videoUrl: null, imageUrl: null, audioUrl: null };
  if (!shot) return empty;
  const videoUrl =
    shot.video_url ||
    (shot.external_video_uri ? await signUri(shot.external_video_uri) : null);
  const imageUrl =
    shot.visual_image_url ||
    (shot.external_image_uri ? await signUri(shot.external_image_uri) : null);
  const audioUrl = shot.external_audio_uri
    ? await signUri(shot.external_audio_uri)
    : null;
  return { videoUrl, imageUrl, audioUrl };
}
````

````
    return '/' + pageName.replace(/ /g, '-');
````

#### `src/hooks/useShotGeneration.js`

*la coda di produzione: genera le inquadrature in ordine, una alla volta, con pausa e ripresa*

````
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";

const CONCURRENCY = 1;
const POLL_MS = 15000;
const MAX_POLLS = 24;

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

export default function useShotGeneration({ shots, onRefresh }) {
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const stopRef = useRef(false);

  const runOne = async (item) => {
    try {
      if (item.status !== "rendering") {
        await base44.functions.invoke("renderShot", { shotId: item.id });
      }
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_POLLS; attempt += 1) {
        if (stopRef.current) return "stopped";
        await wait(attempt === 0 ? 8000 : POLL_MS);
        const response = await base44.functions.invoke("checkShot", { shotId: item.id });
        const status = response?.data?.status;
        if (status === "ready" || status === "failed") {
          await onRefresh();
          return status;
        }
      }
      return "timeout";
    } catch (err) {
      stopRef.current = true;
      setError(
        "Generazione interrotta: controlla i crediti integrazione disponibili e riprova, oppure genera una inquadratura alla volta."
      );
      return "error";
    }
  };

  const start = useCallback(async () => {
    const queue = shots
      .filter((shot) => ["pending", "failed", "rendering"].includes(shot.status))
      .map((shot) => ({ id: shot.id, order: shot.order, status: shot.status }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    if (!queue.length) return;

    stopRef.current = false;
    setError("");
    setRunning(true);
    let cursor = 0;
    let finished = 0;
    const worker = async () => {
      while (cursor < queue.length && !stopRef.current) {
        const item = queue[cursor];
        cursor += 1;
        const result = await runOne(item);
        if (result === "stopped" || result === "error") return;
        if (result !== "timeout") finished += 1;
        setProgress(`${finished} di ${queue.length} completate`);
      }
    };

    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(CONCURRENCY, queue.length) }, worker));
    setRunning(false);
    setProgress("");
    await onRefresh();
  }, [shots, onRefresh]);

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    stopRef.current = true;
  }, []);

  return { running, progress, error, setError, start, stop };
}
````

#### `src/hooks/use-mobile.jsx`

*rileva se il dispositivo è mobile*

````
import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

````

#### `src/hooks/use-size.jsx`

*misura la dimensione di un elemento*

````
import * as React from "react"

export function useSize(ref) {
  const [size, setSize] = React.useState(null)

  // useLayoutEffect (not useEffect): the initial measurement must land before
  // the browser paints, so consumers can render their real content on the
  // very first painted frame instead of a guess. A ResizeObserver's first
  // callback arrives too late for that — by then an <img> src guess has
  // already been dispatched to the network.
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current
    if (!element) return

    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect()
    setSize({ width: rect.width, height: rect.height })

    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
      const { width, height } = entry.contentRect
      setSize({ width, height })
    })

    observer.observe(element)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [ref])

  return size
}

````

### 3.4 Componenti comuni

#### `src/components/ScrollToTop.jsx`

*riporta la pagina in cima alla navigazione*

````
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useLocation, useNavigationType } from "react-router-dom";

const getHashId = (hash) => {
  const rawId = hash.slice(1);

  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(rawId);
  } catch {
    return rawId;
  }
};

export default function ScrollToTop() {
  const { pathname, hash } = useLocation();
  const navigationType = useNavigationType();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (navigationType === "POP") return;

    if (hash) {
      const id = getHashId(hash);
      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
      }, 50);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }

    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: "instant" });
  }, [pathname, hash, navigationType]);

  return null;
}

````

#### `src/components/ProtectedRoute.jsx`

*protegge le pagine: senza login rimanda alla pagina di accesso*

````
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Outlet } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import UserNotRegisteredError from '@/components/UserNotRegisteredError';

const DefaultFallback = () => (
  <div className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
    <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-slate-200 border-t-slate-800 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
  </div>
);

export default function ProtectedRoute({ fallback = <DefaultFallback />, unauthenticatedElement }) {
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoadingAuth, authChecked, authError, checkUserAuth } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authChecked && !isLoadingAuth) {
      checkUserAuth();
    }
  }, [authChecked, isLoadingAuth, checkUserAuth]);

  if (isLoadingAuth || !authChecked) {
    return fallback;
  }

  if (authError) {
    if (authError.type === 'user_not_registered') {
      return <UserNotRegisteredError />;
    }
    return unauthenticatedElement;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return unauthenticatedElement;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
}

````

#### `src/components/studio/NewProjectDialog.jsx`

*finestra per creare una nuova serie (titolo, idea, formato, qualità)*

````
import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { ASPECT_OPTIONS, EPISODE_COUNT_OPTIONS, LENGTH_OPTIONS, QUALITY_OPTIONS } from "@/lib/studioMeta";

export default function NewProjectDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onCreated }) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [brief, setBrief] = useState("");
  const [aspectRatio, setAspectRatio] = useState("9:16");
  const [quality, setQuality] = useState("fast");
  const [targetLength, setTargetLength] = useState("300");
  const [episodeCount, setEpisodeCount] = useState("5");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const submit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || brief.trim().length < 15) {
      setError("Serve un titolo e qualche frase di istruzioni su storia, tono e personaggi.");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const project = await base44.entities.Project.create({
        title: title.trim(),
        brief: brief.trim(),
        aspect_ratio: aspectRatio,
        quality,
        episode_target_seconds: Number(targetLength),
        episode_count: Number(episodeCount),
        language: "Italiano",
        cast_status: "draft",
      });
      setSaving(false);
      onCreated(project);
    } catch (err) {
      setError("Non sono riuscito a salvare il progetto. Riprova.");
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="text-2xl">Nuova serie</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Descrivi cosa vuoi raccontare: l'app crea cast originale, stile visivo, episodi e inquadrature.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="project-title">Titolo della serie</Label>
            <Input
              id="project-title"
              value={title}
              onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Es. Le avventure di Nina e il faro"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="project-brief">Le tue istruzioni</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="project-brief"
              rows={5}
              value={brief}
              onChange={(event) => setBrief(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Es. Serie animata in stile Pixar su una bambina curiosa e un piccolo robot che vivono in un faro sul mare. Storie tenere e avventurose, con un finale che fa sorridere. Ambientazioni costiere al tramonto."
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Formato</Label>
              <Select value={aspectRatio} onValueChange={setAspectRatio}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {ASPECT_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                    <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                      {option.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Qualità</Label>
              <Select value={quality} onValueChange={setQuality}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {QUALITY_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                    <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                      {option.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Durata episodio</Label>
              <Select value={targetLength} onValueChange={setTargetLength}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {LENGTH_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                    <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                      {option.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Numero di episodi</Label>
              <Select value={episodeCount} onValueChange={setEpisodeCount}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {EPISODE_COUNT_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                    <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                      {option.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          {error ? <p className="text-sm text-red-300">{error}</p> : null}
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={saving}>
              {saving ? "Creo la serie…" : "Crea la serie"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

#### `src/components/studio/ShotRow.jsx`

*riga di un'inquadratura: pulsanti Genera (AI, crediti), Gratis (0 crediti) e Importa (file tuoi), stato, costi, dettagli*

````
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Download, RefreshCw, Sparkles, Upload, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import { SHOT_STATUS, formatCredits, formatDuration, shotSeconds } from "@/lib/studioMeta";
import { resolveShotMedia } from "@/lib/shotMedia";
import ImportMedia from "@/components/studio/ImportMedia";
import { Image } from "@/components/ui/image";

export default function ShotRow({ shot, onChanged, blocked, characters = [] }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [importOpen, setImportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [media, setMedia] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    if (!open) return undefined;
    resolveShotMedia(shot).then((resolved) => {
      if (alive) setMedia(resolved);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [open, shot]);
  const status = SHOT_STATUS[shot.status] || SHOT_STATUS.pending;

  const makeFree = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setMessage("");
    const withImage = characters.filter((character) => character.reference_image_url);
    const match = withImage.find((character) => shot.cast?.includes(character.name));
    const visual = match?.reference_image_url || withImage[0]?.reference_image_url;
    if (!visual) {
      setMessage("Serve almeno un'immagine del cast: genera prima il cast nella pagina del progetto.");
      setBusy(false);
      return;
    }
    const motions = ["zoom-in", "zoom-out", "pan-left", "pan-right", "float"];
    try {
      await base44.entities.Shot.update(shot.id, {
        render_mode: "free",
        visual_image_url: visual,
        motion: motions[Math.abs((shot.order || 1) - 1) % motions.length],
        status: "ready",
        credits_spent: 0,
        error: "",
      });
      setMessage("Scena gratuita pronta: 0 crediti.");
      await onChanged();
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage("Creazione della scena gratuita non riuscita. Riprova.");
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  const generate = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setMessage("");
    try {
      await base44.functions.invoke("renderShot", { shotId: shot.id });
      setMessage("Inviata al motore video.");
      await onChanged();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage("Invio non riuscito, riprova.");
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  const check = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await base44.functions.invoke("checkShot", { shotId: shot.id });
      const next = response?.data?.status;
      setMessage(
        next === "ready" ? "Clip pronta." : next === "failed" ? "Generazione non riuscita." : "Ancora in lavorazione."
      );
      await onChanged();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage("Controllo non riuscito, riprova.");
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 sm:p-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              SC{shot.scene_number} · {String(shot.order).padStart(2, "0")}
            </span>
            <Badge className={status.tone}>{status.label}</Badge>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatDuration(shotSeconds(shot))}</span>
            {shot.estimated_credits && shot.status !== "ready" ? (
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">serve ~{formatCredits(shot.estimated_credits)}</span>
            ) : null}
            {shot.credits_spent ? (
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatCredits(shot.credits_spent)} spesi</span>
            ) : null}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-foreground">{shot.title}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{shot.description}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {shot.status === "rendering" ? (
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={check} disabled={busy}>
              Aggiorna
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setImportOpen(true)} disabled={busy || blocked}>
                <Upload className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Importa
              </Button>
              {shot.status !== "ready" ? (
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={makeFree} disabled={busy || blocked}>
                  <Zap className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Gratis
                </Button>
              ) : null}
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={shot.status === "ready" ? "outline" : "default"}
                onClick={generate}
                disabled={busy || blocked}
              >
                {shot.status === "ready" ? <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                {shot.status === "ready" ? "Rigenera" : busy ? "Invio…" : "Genera"}
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            aria-label={open ? "Chiudi dettagli" : "Apri dettagli"}
            onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
          >
            {open ? <ChevronUp className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" />}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {message ? <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{message}</p> : null}
      {shot.error ? <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-red-300">{shot.error}</p> : null}

      {open ? (
        <div className="mt-4 space-y-4 border-t border-border pt-4">
          {media?.videoUrl ? (
            <video
              src={media.videoUrl}
              controls
              playsInline
              className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl bg-black"
            />
          ) : media?.imageUrl ? (
            <Image
              src={media.imageUrl}
              fittingType="fit"
              className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl bg-black"
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              La clip non è ancora stata generata.
            </p>
          )}
          {media?.audioUrl ? (
            <audio src={media.audioUrl} controls className="w-full max-w-md" />
          ) : null}
          {shot.narration_text ? (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Voce fuori campo</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{shot.narration_text}</p>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {shot.cast?.length ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {shot.cast.map((name) => (
                <Badge key={name} variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
                  {name}
                </Badge>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {shot.video_prompt ? (
            <details className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <summary className="cursor-pointer">Prompt inviato al motore video</summary>
              <p className="mt-2 leading-relaxed">{shot.video_prompt}</p>
            </details>
          ) : null}
          {media?.videoUrl ? (
            <a href={media.videoUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary">
                <Download className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Scarica la clip
              </Button>
            </a>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <ImportMedia
        open={importOpen}
        onOpenChange={setImportOpen}
        shot={shot}
        onImported={onChanged}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
````

#### `src/components/studio/ImportMedia.jsx`

*finestra per importare i propri file: clip video (sostituisce la clip AI), immagine (animata come scena gratuita), audio (sostituisce la voce fuori campo)*

````
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Clapperboard, Image as ImageIcon, Music } from "lucide-react";

const SECTIONS = [
  {
    kind: "video",
    label: "Clip video",
    accept: "video/*",
    icon: Clapperboard,
    hint: "Usata al posto della clip AI quando guardi l'episodio. Zero crediti.",
  },
  {
    kind: "image",
    label: "Immagine di scena",
    accept: "image/*",
    icon: ImageIcon,
    hint: "Viene animata nel browser come scena gratuita (zoom, pan, movimento lento).",
  },
  {
    kind: "audio",
    label: "Audio o voce",
    accept: "audio/*",
    icon: Music,
    hint: "Sostituisce la voce fuori campo del browser durante la riproduzione.",
  },
];

export default function ImportMedia({ open, onOpenChange, shot, onImported }) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  const upload = async (event, kind) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    event.target.value = "";
    if (!file) return;
    setBusy(kind);
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const { file_uri } = await base44.integrations.Core.UploadPrivateFile({ file });
      const patch = { error: "" };
      if (kind === "video") {
        patch.external_video_uri = file_uri;
        patch.status = "ready";
      } else if (kind === "image") {
        patch.external_image_uri = file_uri;
        patch.render_mode = "free";
        patch.status = "ready";
      } else {
        patch.external_audio_uri = file_uri;
      }
      await base44.entities.Shot.update(shot.id, patch);
      setMessage(`${SECTIONS.find((section) => section.kind === kind).label} importato.`);
      onImported?.();
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage("Caricamento non riuscito: riprova con un file più leggero.");
    }
    setBusy("");
  };

  const has = (kind) => !!shot?.[`external_${kind}_uri`];

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg border-border bg-card">
        <DialogTitle>Importa i tuoi file</DialogTitle>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Usa le tue clip, immagini o audio su questa inquadratura: zero crediti. I file
          restano privati nel tuo spazio e sono visibili solo agli utenti dell'app.
        </p>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {SECTIONS.map((section) => (
            <div key={section.kind} className="rounded-xl border border-border p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <section.icon className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium">{section.label}</span>
                </div>
                {has(section.kind) ? (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300">
                    presente
                  </Badge>
                ) : null}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{section.hint}</p>
              <input
                type="file"
                accept={section.accept}
                disabled={busy === section.kind}
                onChange={(event) => upload(event, section.kind)}
                className="mt-2 block w-full text-xs text-muted-foreground file:mr-3 file:rounded-md file:border-0 file:bg-secondary file:px-3 file:py-1.5 file:text-xs file:text-secondary-foreground hover:file:bg-accent"
              />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {busy ? <p className="text-xs text-primary">Caricamento in corso…</p> : null}
        {message ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{message}</p> : null}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

#### `src/components/studio/FreeScene.jsx`

*la scena gratuita: immagine del cast o importata, animata nel browser con zoom/pan/deriva*

````
import React from "react";
import { Image } from "@/components/ui/image";

export default function FreeScene({ shot, image, className }) {
  const motion = shot.motion || "zoom-in";
  const duration = Math.max(4, Number(shot.duration_seconds) || 8);

  return (
    <div className={`relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-black ${className || ""}`}>
      <div className="absolute inset-0">
        <Image
          src={image || shot.visual_image_url}
          className={`h-full w-full object-cover scene-${motion}`}
          style={{ "--scene-duration": `${duration}s` }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

#### `src/components/studio/FilmPlayer.jsx`

*il player: unisce clip AI, scene gratuite e clip importate in un episodio, con voce fuori campo (del browser o audio importato) e sottotitoli*

````
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Pause, Play, SkipBack, SkipForward } from "lucide-react";
import FreeScene from "@/components/studio/FreeScene";
import { shotSeconds } from "@/lib/studioMeta";
import { resolveShotMedia } from "@/lib/shotMedia";

const speak = (text) => {
  if (!text || typeof window === "undefined" || !window.speechSynthesis) return;
  window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = "it-IT";
  utterance.rate = 0.98;
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
};

export default function FilmPlayer({ open, onOpenChange, shots, narrationEnabled, aspectRatio, title }) {
  const ready = shots.filter(
    (shot) =>
      shot.status === "ready" &&
      (shot.video_url || shot.visual_image_url || shot.external_video_uri || shot.external_image_uri)
  );
  const [mediaMap, setMediaMap] = useState({});
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
  const [blocked, setBlocked] = useState(false);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const audioRef = useRef(null);
  const mediaFor = (shot) => mediaMap[shot?.id] || {};
  const hasVideo = (shot) => !!shot && !!(shot.video_url || mediaFor(shot).videoUrl);
  const isFree = (shot) =>
    !!shot && !hasVideo(shot) && !!(shot.visual_image_url || mediaFor(shot).imageUrl);
  const current = ready[Math.min(index, ready.length - 1)];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setIndex(0);
      setBlocked(false);
    } else if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.speechSynthesis) {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    }
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    let alive = true;
    Promise.all(
      ready.map(async (shot) => [shot.id, await resolveShotMedia(shot)])
    ).then((entries) => {
      if (alive) setMediaMap(Object.fromEntries(entries));
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [open, ready.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !current) return;
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (video) {
      const attempt = video.play();
      if (attempt?.catch) attempt.catch(() => setBlocked(true));
    }
    if (narrationEnabled) {
      const narrationAudio = mediaFor(current).audioUrl;
      if (narrationAudio) {
        const audio = new Audio(narrationAudio);
        audioRef.current = audio;
        audio.play().catch(() => {});
      } else {
        speak(current.narration_text);
      }
    }
    return () => {
      if (audioRef.current) {
        audioRef.current.pause();
        audioRef.current = null;
      }
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.speechSynthesis) window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    };
  }, [open, index, current?.id, narrationEnabled, mediaMap]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !current || !isFree(current) || paused) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (index + 1 < ready.length) goTo(index + 1);
    }, shotSeconds(current) * 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [open, index, paused, current?.id, ready.length]);

  const goTo = (nextIndex) => {
    setBlocked(false);
    setIndex(Math.max(0, Math.min(nextIndex, ready.length - 1)));
  };

  const togglePlay = () => {
    if (isFree(current)) {
      if (paused) {
        if (narrationEnabled && current) {
          const narrationAudio = mediaFor(current).audioUrl;
          if (narrationAudio && audioRef.current) {
            audioRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
          } else {
            speak(current.narration_text);
          }
        }
      } else {
        audioRef.current?.pause();
        if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.speechSynthesis) window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }
      setPaused(!paused);
      return;
    }
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video) return;
    if (video.paused) {
      const attempt = video.play();
      if (attempt?.catch) attempt.catch(() => setBlocked(true));
      if (narrationEnabled && current) {
        const narrationAudio = mediaFor(current).audioUrl;
        if (narrationAudio && audioRef.current) {
          audioRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
        } else {
          speak(current.narration_text);
        }
      }
    } else {
      video.pause();
      audioRef.current?.pause();
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.speechSynthesis) window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      setBlocked(true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-4xl border-border bg-black/95 p-4 sm:p-6">
        <DialogTitle className="font-display text-lg text-foreground">
          {title} — guarda l'episodio
        </DialogTitle>
        {!ready.length ? (
          <p className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Nessuna inquadratura pronta: generane almeno una.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="relative mx-auto w-full">
              {hasVideo(current) ? (
                <video
                  ref={videoRef}
                  key={current.id}
                  src={current.video_url || mediaFor(current).videoUrl}
                  playsInline
                  onEnded={() => (index + 1 < ready.length ? goTo(index + 1) : undefined)}
                  onError={() => (index + 1 < ready.length ? goTo(index + 1) : undefined)}
                  className={
                    aspectRatio === "16:9"
                      ? "mx-auto aspect-video max-h-[62vh] w-full rounded-xl bg-black"
                      : "mx-auto aspect-[9/16] max-h-[62vh] rounded-xl bg-black"
                  }
                />
              ) : (
                <FreeScene
                  shot={current}
                  image={mediaFor(current).imageUrl || null}
                  className={
                    aspectRatio === "16:9"
                      ? "mx-auto aspect-video max-h-[62vh] w-full rounded-xl bg-black"
                      : "mx-auto aspect-[9/16] max-h-[62vh] w-full rounded-xl bg-black"
                  }
                />
              )}
              {blocked || (isFree(current) && paused) ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={togglePlay}
                  className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-black/45 text-foreground"
                >
                  <Play className="h-10 w-10" />
                </button>
              ) : null}
              {narrationEnabled && current.narration_text ? (
                <div className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 rounded-b-xl bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 to-transparent px-4 pb-4 pt-10">
                  <p className="text-center text-sm leading-relaxed text-white drop-shadow">
                    {current.narration_text}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" onClick={() => goTo(index - 1)} disabled={index === 0}>
                <SkipBack className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
              <Button size="icon" variant="secondary" onClick={togglePlay}>
                <Pause className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
              <Progress value={((index + 1) / ready.length) * 100} className="h-1.5 flex-1" />
              <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" onClick={() => goTo(index + 1)} disabled={index >= ready.length - 1}>
                <SkipForward className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
              <span className="w-24 shrink-0 text-right font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {index + 1}/{ready.length}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

#### `src/components/studio/SocialPack.jsx`

*pacchetto social: titolo, descrizione e hashtag pronti da copiare*

````
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Copy, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";

export default function SocialPack({ open, onOpenChange, episode, onChanged }) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(episode.publish_title || "");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(episode.publish_description || "");
  const [hashtags, setHashtags] = useState(episode.publish_hashtags || []);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const generate = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const response = await base44.functions.invoke("generatePublishPack", { episodeId: episode.id });
      const updated = response?.data?.episode;
      if (updated) {
        setTitle(updated.publish_title || "");
        setDescription(updated.publish_description || "");
        setHashtags(updated.publish_hashtags || []);
      }
      await onChanged();
    } catch (err) {
      setError("Non sono riuscito a scrivere il pacchetto. Riprova tra qualche istante.");
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  const copy = async (label, text) => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopied(label);
  };

  const fullText = [title, "", description, "", hashtags.map((tag) => `#${tag}`).join(" ")]
    .join("\n")
    .trim();

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="text-2xl">Pacchetto social</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Titolo, descrizione e hashtag pronti da incollare quando pubblichi questo episodio.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Button onClick={generate} disabled={busy} variant={title ? "secondary" : "default"}>
            <Sparkles className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            {busy ? "Scrivo il pacchetto…" : title ? "Rigenera il pacchetto" : "Genera il pacchetto"}
          </Button>

          {title ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <p className="font-display text-lg">{title}</p>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => copy("titolo", title)}>
                    <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
                <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="mt-2" onClick={() => copy("descrizione", description)}>
                  <Copy className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Copia descrizione
                </Button>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {hashtags.map((tag) => (
                  <Badge key={tag} variant="outline" className="border-primary/40 text-primary">
                    #{tag}
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
              <Button size="sm" onClick={() => copy("tutto", fullText)}>
                <Copy className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Copia tutto
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {error ? <p className="text-sm text-red-300">{error}</p> : null}
          {copied ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Copiato: {copied}.</p> : null}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

#### `src/components/studio/CreditsPanel.jsx`

*dashboard crediti: consumato, in sospeso, disponibile, reset mensile*

````
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Coins } from "lucide-react";
import { formatCredits } from "@/lib/studioMeta";

export default function CreditsPanel() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [available, setAvailable] = useState("");
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const [rows, me] = await Promise.all([
      base44.entities.Shot.aggregate({ groupBy: "status", sum: ["credits_spent", "estimated_credits"] }),
      base44.auth.me().catch(() => null),
    ]);
    let consumed = 0;
    let needed = 0;
    let pendingCount = 0;
    (rows?.rows || []).forEach((row) => {
      consumed += Number(row.sum_credits_spent) || 0;
      if (row.status === "pending" || row.status === "failed") {
        needed += Number(row.sum_estimated_credits) || 0;
        pendingCount += Number(row.count) || 0;
      }
    });
    setStats({ consumed, needed, pendingCount });
    setAvailable(String(me?.credits_available ?? 100));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const saveBudget = async () => {
    const value = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(available) || 0));
    setAvailable(String(value));
    setSaved(false);
    try {
      await base44.auth.updateMe({ credits_available: value });
      setSaved(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setSaved(false);
    }
  };

  if (!stats) return null;

  const now = new Date();
  const resetMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 1);
  const resetLabel = `1° ${resetMonth.toLocaleDateString("it-IT", { month: "long" })}`;
  const budget = Number(available) || 0;
  const afterPending = budget - stats.needed;

  return (
    <section className="mt-10 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl">
          <Coins className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          Crediti
        </h2>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Il piano si azzera ogni mese · prossimo: {resetLabel}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Consumato (video)</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold">{formatCredits(stats.consumed)}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Clip già generate in tutte le serie.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Serve per le clip in sospeso</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {stats.needed ? formatCredits(stats.needed) : stats.pendingCount ? "—" : "0 crediti"}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {stats.needed
              ? `${stats.pendingCount} clip da generare.`
              : stats.pendingCount
                ? `${stats.pendingCount} clip da generare: apri l'episodio e premi "Stima crediti".`
                : "Nessuna clip in attesa."}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Disponibili</p>
          <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Input
              className="h-9 w-24"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={available}
              onChange={(event) => setAvailable(event.target.value)}
              onBlur={saveBudget}
            />
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {saved ? "salvato" : "modifica e clicca fuori per salvare"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {afterPending >= 0
              ? `Dopo le clip in sospeso: ~${formatCredits(afterPending)}.`
              : `Non bastano: mancano ~${formatCredits(-afterPending)}.`}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        Il saldo preciso del piano lo trovi nel workspace (Plan and billing). La scrittura di cast,
        episodi e pacchetti social sono voci piccole in più: pochi crediti a chiamata.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}
````

#### `src/components/studio/GoogleKeyBox.jsx`

*gestione della chiave Google AI: inserimento, verifica, salvataggio nel profilo*

````
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { CheckCircle2, ClipboardPaste, ExternalLink, KeyRound, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

export default function GoogleKeyBox() {
  const [savedKey, setSavedKey] = useState(null);
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [ok, setOk] = useState(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const me = await base44.auth.me().catch(() => null);
    const key = me?.google_api_key || "";
    setSavedKey(key);
    setValue(key);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const paste = async () => {
    try {
      const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
      setValue(text.trim());
      setMessage("");
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage("Il browser non ha permesso di leggere gli appunti: incolla con CTRL+V.");
    }
  };

  const save = async () => {
    const key = value.trim();
    if (!key) {
      setMessage("Incolla prima la chiave.");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setMessage("");
    setOk(null);
    try {
      await base44.auth.updateMe({ google_api_key: key });
      const response = await base44.functions.invoke("verifyGoogleKey", { apiKey: key });
      const valid = !!response?.data?.valid;
      setSavedKey(key);
      setOk(valid);
      const reason = response?.data?.reason;
      setMessage(
        valid
          ? "Chiave valida e salvata: sostituisce la precedente."
          : `Chiave salvata, ma Google la rifiuta${reason ? `: ${reason}` : ": ricontrollala su AI Studio."}`
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage("Non sono riuscito a salvare la chiave. Riprova.");
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  const remove = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.updateMe({ google_api_key: "" });
      setSavedKey("");
      setValue("");
      setOk(null);
      setMessage("Chiave rimossa.");
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage("Rimozione non riuscita.");
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  const masked = savedKey ? `${savedKey.slice(0, 4)}••••••${savedKey.slice(-4)}` : "";

  return (
    <section className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl">
          <KeyRound className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          Motore Google (opzionale)
        </h2>
        {savedKey ? (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
            Chiave attiva: <span className="font-mono">{masked}</span>
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Con una chiave Google AI Studio lo studio può continuare a generare video con i limiti
        gratuiti di Google quando i crediti Base44 finiscono. La chiave resta sul tuo account
        (mai nel codice, invisibile agli altri utenti) e ogni incollata sostituisce la
        precedente. Nessun lavoro viene mai cancellato: le clip si riprendono dal punto in cui
        si era fermato.
      </p>
      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Input
          className="max-w-xs"
          type="password"
          placeholder="AIza…"
          value={value}
          onChange={(event) => setValue(event.target.value)}
        />
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={paste}>
          <ClipboardPaste className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          Incolla
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={save} disabled={busy}>
          {busy ? "Verifico…" : "Salva e verifica"}
        </Button>
        {savedKey ? (
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={remove} disabled={busy}>
            <Trash2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            Rimuovi
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {message ? (
        <p className={`mt-3 text-xs ${ok ? "text-emerald-300" : ok === false ? "text-red-300" : "text-muted-foreground"}`}>
          {message}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <a
        className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-primary hover:underline"
        href="https://aistudio.google.com/apikey"
        target="_blank"
        rel="noreferrer"
      >
        <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        Recupera la tua chiave su Google AI Studio
      </a>
    </section>
  );
}
````
