### 3.7 Pagine

#### `src/pages/Home.jsx`

*dashboard: serie esistenti, nuova serie, crediti, chiave Google*

````
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Plus, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import CreditsPanel from "@/components/studio/CreditsPanel";
import GoogleKeyBox from "@/components/studio/GoogleKeyBox";
import ProjectCard from "@/components/studio/ProjectCard";
import NewProjectDialog from "@/components/studio/NewProjectDialog";

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState(null);
  const [episodeCounts, setEpisodeCounts] = useState({});
  const [covers, setCovers] = useState({});
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const { items } = await base44.entities.Project.filter({}, { sort: "-updated_date", limit: 24 });
    setProjects(items);

    const ids = items.map((project) => project.id);
    if (!ids.length) return;

    const counts = await base44.entities.Episode.aggregate({
      query: { project_id: { $in: ids } },
      groupBy: "project_id",
    });
    const countMap = {};
    (counts?.rows || []).forEach((row) => {
      countMap[row.project_id] = row.count;
    });
    setEpisodeCounts(countMap);

    const { items: characters } = await base44.entities.Character.filter(
      { project_id: { $in: ids } },
      { sort: "sort_order", limit: 200, fields: ["project_id", "reference_image_url"] }
    );
    const coverMap = {};
    characters.forEach((character) => {
      if (!coverMap[character.project_id] && character.reference_image_url) {
        coverMap[character.project_id] = character.reference_image_url;
      }
    });
    setCovers(coverMap);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  if (!projects) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-[60vh] items-center justify-center">
        <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-border border-t-primary" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-5 py-10 sm:px-8 sm:py-14">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-6">
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">Studio di animazione</p>
          <h1 className="text-4xl leading-tight sm:text-5xl">I tuoi film</h1>
          <p className="max-w-xl text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:text-base">
            Scrivi le tue istruzioni: lo studio crea cast originale in stile Pixar, scrive episodi da
            5 minuti e li genera inquadratura per inquadratura, pronti per i tuoi social.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button size="lg" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}>
          <Plus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          Nuova serie
        </Button>
      </header>

      <CreditsPanel />
      <GoogleKeyBox />

      {projects.length ? (
        <div className="mt-10 grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {projects.map((project) => (
            <ProjectCard
              key={project.id}
              project={project}
              coverUrl={covers[project.id]}
              episodeCount={episodeCounts[project.id]}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-12 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border bg-card/50 p-10 text-center">
          <Sparkles className="mx-auto h-8 w-8 text-primary" />
          <h2 className="mt-4 text-2xl">Inizia dalla tua prima serie</h2>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Racconta in poche frasi il mondo, i personaggi e il tono che vuoi. Da lì nascono cast,
            episodi e inquadrature.
          </p>
          <Button className="mt-6" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}>
            Crea la prima serie
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      <NewProjectDialog
        open={dialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
        onCreated={(project) => {
          setDialogOpen(false);
          navigate(`/progetto/${project.id}`);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
````

#### `src/pages/ProjectDetail.jsx`

*la serie: cast, episodi e pulsanti di produzione*

````
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { ArrowLeft, Film, Plus, Sparkles, Users } from "lucide-react";
import CastPanel from "@/components/studio/CastPanel";
import EpisodeRow from "@/components/studio/EpisodeRow";

export default function ProjectDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [project, setProject] = useState(null);
  const [cast, setCast] = useState([]);
  const [episodes, setEpisodes] = useState([]);
  const [counts, setCounts] = useState({});
  const [readyCounts, setReadyCounts] = useState({});
  const [creditsSpent, setCreditsSpent] = useState({});
  const [casting, setCasting] = useState(false);
  const [episodeOpen, setEpisodeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [idea, setIdea] = useState("");
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [videoBusy, setVideoBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const [projectData, characters, episodePage] = await Promise.all([
      base44.entities.Project.get(id),
      base44.entities.Character.filter({ project_id: id }, { sort: "sort_order", limit: 10 }),
      base44.entities.Episode.filter({ project_id: id }, { sort: "episode_number", limit: 50 }),
    ]);
    setProject(projectData);
    setCast(characters?.items || []);
    const list = episodePage?.items || [];
    setEpisodes(list);

    const ids = list.map((episode) => episode.id);
    if (!ids.length) return;

    const [total, ready] = await Promise.all([
      base44.entities.Shot.aggregate({ query: { episode_id: { $in: ids } }, groupBy: "episode_id", sum: "credits_spent" }),
      base44.entities.Shot.aggregate({
        query: { episode_id: { $in: ids }, status: "ready" },
        groupBy: "episode_id",
      }),
    ]);
    const totalMap = {};
    const readyMap = {};
    const creditsMap = {};
    (total?.rows || []).forEach((row) => {
      totalMap[row.episode_id] = row.count;
      creditsMap[row.episode_id] = Number(row.sum_credits_spent) || 0;
    });
    (ready?.rows || []).forEach((row) => {
      readyMap[row.episode_id] = row.count;
    });
    setCounts(totalMap);
    setReadyCounts(readyMap);
    setCreditsSpent(creditsMap);
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const generateCast = async () => {
    setCasting(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await base44.functions.invoke("generateSeries", { projectId: id });
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      setError("La creazione del cast non è riuscita. Riprova.");
    }
    setCasting(false);
  };

  const createEpisode = async () => {
    setCreating(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const response = await base44.functions.invoke("generateEpisode", { projectId: id, idea: idea.trim() });
      const episode = response?.data?.episode;
      setCreating(false);
      setEpisodeOpen(false);
      if (episode) navigate(`/episodio/${episode.id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError("La scrittura dell'episodio non è riuscita. Riprova.");
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const videoTarget = episodes.find(
    (item) => !counts[item.id] || readyCounts[item.id] < counts[item.id]
  );
  const plannedEpisodes = Math.max(1, Number(project?.episode_count) || 1);
  const nextNumber = episodes.length + 1;
  const minutesTarget = Math.round((project?.episode_target_seconds || 300) / 60);
  const planLabel = plannedEpisodes === 1 ? "1 episodio" : `${plannedEpisodes} episodi`;
  const videoLabel = videoBusy
    ? "Scrivo l'episodio…"
    : videoTarget
      ? `Genera il video — episodio ${videoTarget.episode_number} di ${plannedEpisodes}`
      : nextNumber > plannedEpisodes
        ? "Genera un episodio extra"
        : `Genera video — episodio ${nextNumber} di ${plannedEpisodes}`;

  const generateVideo = async () => {
    if (videoTarget) {
      navigate(`/episodio/${videoTarget.id}`);
      return;
    }
    setVideoBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const response = await base44.functions.invoke("generateEpisode", { projectId: id });
      const episode = response?.data?.episode;
      if (episode) navigate(`/episodio/${episode.id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError("La scrittura dell'episodio non è riuscita. Riprova.");
    }
    setVideoBusy(false);
  };

  if (!project) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-[60vh] items-center justify-center">
        <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-border border-t-primary" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-5 py-10 sm:px-8 sm:py-14">
      <Link to="/" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
        <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
        Tutte le serie
      </Link>

      <header className="mt-6 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <h1 className="text-4xl leading-tight sm:text-5xl">{project.title}</h1>
            {project.style ? (
              <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:text-base">{project.style}</p>
            ) : (
              <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:text-base">{project.brief}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <Button onClick={() => setEpisodeOpen(true)} disabled={project.cast_status !== "ready" || !!videoTarget}>
            <Plus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            Nuovo episodio
          </Button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {project.genre ? <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">{project.genre}</Badge> : null}
          {project.audience ? <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">{project.audience}</Badge> : null}
          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
            {project.aspect_ratio === "16:9" ? "Cinema 16:9" : "Verticale 9:16"}
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
            {project.quality === "cinema" ? "Alta qualità" : "Veloce"}
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
            {planLabel} da {minutesTarget} min
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </header>

      {error ? <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-red-300">{error}</p> : null}

      <section className="mt-12 space-y-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl">
            <Users className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
            Cast della serie
          </h2>
          {cast.length ? (
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={generateCast} disabled={casting}>
              {casting ? "Ricreo il cast…" : "Ricrea il cast"}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {cast.length ? (
          <CastPanel characters={cast} aspectRatio={project.aspect_ratio} />
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border bg-card/50 p-8 text-center">
            <Sparkles className="mx-auto h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
            <h3 className="mt-3 text-xl">Primo passo: creare il cast</h3>
            <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-lg text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Lo studio definisce da 2 a 4 protagonisti originali con immagini di riferimento, così i
              personaggi restano identici in ogni episodio.
            </p>
            <Button className="mt-5" onClick={generateCast} disabled={casting}>
              {casting ? "Creo cast e stile…" : "Genera cast e stile"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="mt-14 space-y-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <h2 className="text-xl">Episodi</h2>
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {episodes.length} di {plannedEpisodes} scritti
          </span>
        </div>
        {videoTarget ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Produzione in ordine: completa l'episodio {videoTarget.episode_number} (tutte le
            inquadrature pronte) per sbloccare la scrittura del prossimo.
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {episodes.length ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {episodes.map((episode) => (
              <EpisodeRow
                key={episode.id}
                episode={episode}
                shotCount={counts[episode.id] || 0}
                readyCount={readyCounts[episode.id] || 0}
                creditsSpent={creditsSpent[episode.id] || 0}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Ancora nessun episodio: usa il pulsante qui sotto per generare il primo video.
          </p>
        )}
      </section>

      {cast.length ? (
        <section className="mt-14 rounded-3xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-6 text-center sm:p-8">
          <Film className="mx-auto h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
          <h2 className="mt-3 text-2xl">Pronto per il video</h2>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {videoTarget
              ? `Episodio ${videoTarget.episode_number} di ${plannedEpisodes} già scritto: ${counts[videoTarget.id] || 0} inquadrature da generare, ognuna una clip da 6 a 15 secondi che il player unisce in un episodio unico.`
              : `La serie è prevista in ${planLabel} da ${minutesTarget} minuti. Lo studio scrive l'episodio ${nextNumber} con scene, inquadrature e voce fuori campo, poi lo apre per la generazione delle clip: 6-15 secondi ciascuna, unite dal player in un episodio unico.`}
          </p>
          <Button size="lg" className="mt-5 w-full sm:w-auto" onClick={generateVideo} disabled={videoBusy}>
            <Film className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            {videoLabel}
          </Button>
        </section>
      ) : null}

      <Dialog open={episodeOpen} onOpenChange={setEpisodeOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-xl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="text-2xl">Nuovo episodio</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Lo studio scrive trama, scene e inquadrature da {Math.round((project.episode_target_seconds || 300) / 60)} minuti con la voce fuori campo.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <Textarea
            rows={4}
            value={idea}
            onChange={(event) => setIdea(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="Facoltativo: l'idea per questo episodio. Es. Nina trova un gabbiano ferito e il robot scopre di avere paura del mare."
          />
          <Button onClick={createEpisode} disabled={creating}>
            {creating ? "Scrivo l'episodio…" : "Scrivi l'episodio"}
          </Button>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
````

#### `src/pages/EpisodeDetail.jsx`

*l'episodio: inquadrature in ordine, stima crediti, player, pacchetto social*

````
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { ArrowLeft, Calculator, Film, Share2, Sparkles, Square } from "lucide-react";
import ShotRow from "@/components/studio/ShotRow";
import FilmPlayer from "@/components/studio/FilmPlayer";
import SocialPack from "@/components/studio/SocialPack";
import useShotGeneration from "@/hooks/useShotGeneration";
import { formatCredits, formatDuration, shotSeconds } from "@/lib/studioMeta";

export default function EpisodeDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const [episode, setEpisode] = useState(null);
  const [project, setProject] = useState(null);
  const [shots, setShots] = useState([]);
  const [estimate, setEstimate] = useState(null);
  const [estimating, setEstimating] = useState(false);
  const [playerOpen, setPlayerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [packOpen, setPackOpen] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [blocker, setBlocker] = useState(null);
  const [characters, setCharacters] = useState([]);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const episodeData = await base44.entities.Episode.get(id);
    setEpisode(episodeData);
    const [projectData, shotPage, characterPage] = await Promise.all([
      base44.entities.Project.get(episodeData.project_id),
      base44.entities.Shot.filter({ episode_id: id }, { sort: "order", limit: 60 }),
      base44.entities.Character.filter({ project_id: episodeData.project_id }, { sort: "sort_order", limit: 10 }),
    ]);
    setProject(projectData);
    setCharacters(characterPage?.items || []);
    const list = shotPage?.items || [];
    setShots(list);

    const missingEstimates = list.some(
      (item) => !item.estimated_credits && (item.status === "pending" || item.status === "failed")
    );
    if (missingEstimates) {
      try {
        await base44.functions.invoke("estimateEpisodeCost", { episodeId: id });
        const refreshed = await base44.entities.Shot.filter({ episode_id: id }, { sort: "order", limit: 60 });
        setShots(refreshed?.items || []);
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    const earlierPage = await base44.entities.Episode.filter(
      { project_id: episodeData.project_id, episode_number: { $lt: episodeData.episode_number } },
      { sort: "episode_number", limit: 50, fields: ["id", "episode_number"] }
    );
    const earlierItems = earlierPage?.items || [];
    let earlierBlocker = null;
    if (earlierItems.length) {
      const pendingPage = await base44.entities.Shot.filter(
        { episode_id: { $in: earlierItems.map((item) => item.id) }, status: { $ne: "ready" } },
        { sort: "order", limit: 100, fields: ["episode_id"] }
      );
      const pendingEpisodeIds = new Set((pendingPage?.items || []).map((shot) => shot.episode_id));
      const blockingEpisode = earlierItems.find((item) => pendingEpisodeIds.has(item.id));
      earlierBlocker = blockingEpisode ? blockingEpisode.episode_number : null;
    }
    setBlocker(earlierBlocker);
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const { running, progress, error: runnerError, start, stop } = useShotGeneration({ shots, onRefresh: load });

  const unlockedMap = {};
  let previousReady = true;
  shots.forEach((shot) => {
    unlockedMap[shot.id] = previousReady;
    if (shot.status !== "ready") previousReady = false;
  });

  const pending = shots.filter((shot) => shot.status !== "ready");
  const ready = shots.filter(
    (shot) =>
      shot.status === "ready" &&
      (shot.video_url || shot.visual_image_url || shot.external_video_uri || shot.external_image_uri)
  );
  const plannedSeconds = shots.reduce((total, shot) => total + shotSeconds(shot), 0);
  const creditsSpent = shots.reduce((total, shot) => total + (Number(shot.credits_spent) || 0), 0);
  const readySeconds = ready.reduce((total, shot) => total + shotSeconds(shot), 0);
  const complete = shots.length > 0 && pending.length === 0;

  const estimateCost = async () => {
    setEstimating(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const response = await base44.functions.invoke("estimateEpisodeCost", { episodeId: id });
      setEstimate(response?.data);
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      setError("La stima non è disponibile in questo momento.");
    }
    setEstimating(false);
  };

  if (!episode || !project) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-[60vh] items-center justify-center">
        <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-border border-t-primary" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl px-5 py-10 sm:px-8 sm:py-14">
      <Link
        to={`/progetto/${project.id}`}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
      >
        <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
        {project.title}
      </Link>

      <header className="mt-6 space-y-4">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">
          Episodio {episode.episode_number}
          {project.episode_count && episode.episode_number <= project.episode_count
            ? ` di ${project.episode_count}`
            : ""}
        </p>
        <h1 className="text-3xl leading-tight sm:text-4xl">{episode.title}</h1>
        <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:text-base">
          {episode.logline || episode.synopsis}
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
            {ready.length}/{shots.length} inquadrature pronte
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
            {formatDuration(readySeconds)} generati · obiettivo {formatDuration(episode.target_seconds || 300)}
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
            {project.aspect_ratio === "16:9" ? "Cinema 16:9" : "Verticale 9:16"}
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
            {project.quality === "cinema" ? "Alta qualità" : "Veloce"}
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
            {formatCredits(creditsSpent)} crediti spesi
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Button onClick={() => setPlayerOpen(true)} disabled={!ready.length}>
          <Film className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          Guarda l'episodio
        </Button>
        {running ? (
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={stop}>
            <Square className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            Interrompi
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={start} disabled={!pending.length || !!blocker}>
            <Sparkles className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            {pending.length ? `Genera le ${pending.length} mancanti` : "Tutto generato"}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={estimateCost} disabled={estimating || !pending.length}>
          <Calculator className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          {estimating ? "Calcolo…" : "Stima crediti"}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setPackOpen(true)}>
          <Share2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          Pacchetto social
        </Button>
      </div>

      {blocker ? (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-4 text-sm">
          Lo studio produce gli episodi in ordine: completa prima l'episodio {blocker} (tutte le sue
          inquadrature pronte) per generare le clip di questo. Così pubblichi l'episodio {blocker}{" "}
          mentre gli altri sono ancora in produzione.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {running ? (
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-primary">
          Generazione in corso — {progress || "avvio…"}. Puoi lasciare la pagina aperta: una inquadratura alla volta, in ordine.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {estimate ? (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-4 text-sm">
          {estimate.shotCount ? (
            <p>
              Stima per {estimate.shotCount} inquadrature mancanti: <strong>{formatCredits(estimate.total)}</strong>.{" "}
              {(estimate.perClip || []).map((clip) => (
                <span key={`${clip.model}-${clip.seconds}`} className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {clip.count} clip da {clip.seconds}s a {clip.resolution} ≈ {formatCredits(clip.credits)} ciascuna.{" "}
                </span>
              ))}
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                Stima indicativa e non addebitata. Ogni clip generata consuma i crediti integrazione del tuo
                piano: il video è la voce più cara, quindi controlla qui prima di far partire le inquadrature.
              </span>
            </p>
          ) : (
            <p>Tutte le inquadrature sono già generate: nessun credito da spendere.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {runnerError ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-300">{runnerError}</p> : null}
      {error ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-300">{error}</p> : null}

      <section className="mt-10 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="text-xl">Inquadrature</h2>
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {shots.length} inquadrature · {formatDuration(plannedSeconds)} di film previsti
          </span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Ogni inquadratura è una clip da 6 a 15 secondi: il player le unisce in un unico episodio da{" "}
          {Math.round((episode.target_seconds || 300) / 60)} minuti.
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Produzione in ordine: ogni inquadratura si sblocca quando la precedente è pronta. Con il
          pulsante "Gratis" crei la scena animando le immagini del cast nel browser: zero crediti.
        </p>
        {shots.map((shot) => (
          <ShotRow
            key={shot.id}
            shot={shot}
            blocked={!!blocker || !unlockedMap[shot.id]}
            characters={characters}
            onChanged={load}
          />
        ))}
      </section>

      {complete ? (
        <div className="mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 p-5 text-sm">
          Episodio completo: guardalo nell'app, scarica le clip per il montaggio finale e usa il
          pacchetto social per pubblicarlo.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <FilmPlayer
        open={playerOpen}
        onOpenChange={setPlayerOpen}
        shots={shots}
        narrationEnabled={episode.narration_enabled}
        aspectRatio={project.aspect_ratio}
        title={episode.title}
      />
      <SocialPack open={packOpen} onOpenChange={setPackOpen} episode={episode} onChanged={load} />
    </div>
  );
}
````

#### `src/pages/Login.jsx`

*accesso con email/password o Google*

````
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { LogIn, Mail, Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import { safeReturnTo } from "@/lib/authReturnTo";

export default function Login() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  // Post-login destination (e.g. the MCP OAuth consent page sends users here
  // with returnTo so the grant flow can resume). Same-origin paths only.
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo();

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.loginViaEmailPassword(email, password);
      window.location.href = returnTo;
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Invalid email or password");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGoogle = () => {
    base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", returnTo);
  };

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={LogIn}
      title="Welcome back"
      subtitle="Log in to your account"
      footer={
        <>
          Don't have an account?{" "}
          <Link
            to={"/register" + (returnTo !== "/" ? "?returnTo=" + encodeURIComponent(returnTo) : "")}
            className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline"
          >
            Create one
          </Link>
        </>
      }
    >
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        className="w-full h-12 text-sm font-medium mb-6"
        onClick={handleGoogle}
      >
        <GoogleIcon className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
        Continue with Google
      </Button>

      <div className="relative mb-6">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
          <div className="w-full border-t border-border" />
        </div>
        <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
          <span className="bg-card px-3 text-muted-foreground">or</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              autoFocus
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
            <Link to="/forgot-password" className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline">
              Forgot password?
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="current-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Logging in...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Log in"
          )}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

````

#### `src/pages/Register.jsx`

*registrazione con verifica via codice OTP*

````
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { UserPlus, Mail, Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot } from "@/components/ui/input-otp";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import { toast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";
import { safeReturnTo } from "@/lib/authReturnTo";

export default function Register() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showOtp, setShowOtp] = useState(false);
  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.register({ email, password });
      setShowOtp(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Registration failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerify = async () => {
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await base44.auth.verifyOtp({ email, otpCode });
      if (result?.access_token) {
        base44.auth.setToken(result.access_token);
      }
      window.location.href = safeReturnTo();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Invalid verification code");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResend = async () => {
    setError("");
    try {
      await base44.auth.resendOtp(email);
      toast({
        title: "Code sent",
        description: "Check your email for the new code.",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to resend code");
    }
  };

  const handleGoogle = () => {
    base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", safeReturnTo());
  };

  if (showOtp) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout
        icon={Mail}
        title="Verify your email"
        subtitle={`We sent a code to ${email}`}
      >
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
          <InputOTP
            maxLength={6}
            value={otpCode}
            onChange={setOtpCode}
            autoFocus
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
          >
            <InputOTPGroup>
              <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
            </InputOTPGroup>
          </InputOTP>
        </div>
        <Button
          className="w-full h-12 font-medium"
          onClick={handleVerify}
          disabled={loading || otpCode.length < 6}
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Verifying...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Verify"
          )}
        </Button>
        <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-4">
          Didn't receive the code?{" "}
          <button onClick={handleResend} className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline">
            Resend
          </button>
        </p>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={UserPlus}
      title="Create your account"
      subtitle="Sign up to get started"
      footer={
        <>
          Already have an account?{" "}
          <Link
            to={"/login" + (safeReturnTo() !== "/" ? "?returnTo=" + encodeURIComponent(safeReturnTo()) : "")}
            className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline"
          >
            Log in
          </Link>
        </>
      }
    >
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        className="w-full h-12 text-sm font-medium mb-6"
        onClick={handleGoogle}
      >
        <GoogleIcon className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
        Continue with Google
      </Button>

      <div className="relative mb-6">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
          <div className="w-full border-t border-border" />
        </div>
        <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
          <span className="bg-card px-3 text-muted-foreground">or</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              autoFocus
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="confirm">Confirm Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="confirm"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Creating account...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Create account"
          )}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

````

#### `src/pages/ForgotPassword.jsx`

*richiesta reset password*

````
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Mail, ArrowLeft, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";

export default function ForgotPassword() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.resetPasswordRequest(email);
    } catch {
      // Always show success regardless
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setSent(true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={Mail}
      title="Reset password"
      subtitle="We'll send you a link to reset it"
      footer={
        <Link to="/login" className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline">
          <ArrowLeft className="w-3 h-3 inline mr-1" />Back to log in
        </Link>
      }
    >
      {sent ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-foreground text-center">
          If an account exists with that email, you'll receive a password reset link shortly.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="email">Email address</Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
              <Input
                id="email"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                autoFocus
                placeholder="you@example.com"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-10 h-12"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                Sending...
              </>
            ) : (
              "Send reset link"
            )}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

````

#### `src/pages/ResetPassword.jsx`

*imposta la nuova password con il token ricevuto*

````
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Lock, Loader2, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";

export default function ResetPassword() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const resetToken = searchParams.get("token");

  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.resetPassword({ resetToken, newPassword });
      window.location.href = "/login";
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to reset password");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!resetToken) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout
        icon={AlertTriangle}
        title="Invalid reset link"
        subtitle="This password reset link is missing or invalid"
        footer={
          <Link to="/forgot-password" className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline">
            Request a new link
          </Link>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-foreground text-center">
          The link you used appears to be incomplete. Please request a new password reset email.
        </p>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={Lock}
      title="New password"
      subtitle="Enter your new password below"
    >
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="password">New Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              autoFocus
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={newPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="confirm">Confirm Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="confirm"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Resetting...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Reset password"
          )}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

````

#### `src/pages/OAuthConsent.jsx`

*consenso all'accesso con provider social*

````
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { appParams } from "@/lib/app-params";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ShieldCheck, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";

const OPERATION_VERBS = { read: "view", create: "create", update: "edit", delete: "delete" };
const COLLAPSED_DATA_ROWS = 6;

// Entity tools arrive one per operation; show each entity once, naming only the
// operations it actually grants.
function groupTools(tools) {
  const operationsByEntity = new Map();
  const agents = [];
  const actions = [];
  for (const tool of tools) {
    if (tool.kind === "entity" && tool.entity) {
      if (!operationsByEntity.has(tool.entity)) operationsByEntity.set(tool.entity, []);
      operationsByEntity.get(tool.entity).push(tool.operation);
    } else if (tool.kind === "agent") {
      agents.push(tool);
    } else {
      actions.push(tool);
    }
  }
  const data = [...operationsByEntity].map(([entity, operations]) => ({
    entity,
    operations: Object.keys(OPERATION_VERBS).filter((op) => operations.includes(op)),
  }));
  return { data, agents, actions };
}

const humanize = (name) =>
  name.split(/[_-]+/).filter(Boolean).map((word) => word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)).join(" ") || name;

// "View, create and delete records" — delete is emphasized so it doesn't hide
// among harmless verbs.
function OperationSummary({ operations }) {
  return (
    <>
      {operations.map((op, i) => {
        const verb = OPERATION_VERBS[op];
        const separator = i === 0 ? "" : i === operations.length - 1 ? " and " : ", ";
        return (
          <React.Fragment key={op}>
            {separator}
            <span className={op === "delete" ? "font-medium text-destructive" : undefined}>
              {i === 0 ? verb[0].toUpperCase() + verb.slice(1) : verb}
            </span>
          </React.Fragment>
        );
      })}{" "}
      records
    </>
  );
}

function ToolSection({ title, children }) {
  return (
    <section>
      <h3 className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground mb-2">{title}</h3>
      <ul className="divide-y divide-border rounded-lg border border-border">{children}</ul>
    </section>
  );
}

function ToolRow({ title, children }) {
  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 px-3 py-2">
      <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{title}</span>
      {children && <span className="text-muted-foreground">{children}</span>}
    </li>
  );
}

// App-side OAuth consent page for the app's MCP server. The platform redirects
// AI clients here (see base44/mcp/config.json `consent_path`) with an opaque
// `ctx` handle — the authorization request itself lives on the server. This page
// gates on the app-user session, fetches the display info for that handle, shows
// the categories of access being granted, and posts the approve/deny decision.
// Do not change the fetch calls, headers, or the `ctx` handle handling — styling
// and copy are safe to edit.
export default function OAuthConsent() {
  const ctx = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("ctx");
  const [info, setInfo] = useState(null);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [decided, setDecided] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [reconnect, setReconnect] = useState("");
  const [showAllData, setShowAllData] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      let redirecting = false;
      try {
        if (!ctx) {
          setError("This authorization link is invalid or has expired.");
          return;
        }
        // Resolve the handle first: a dead handle must never render
        // approve/deny, and the response carries the app's configured login
        // route for the signed-out redirect below. Send the session (cookie +
        // bearer token) so the server can list the granted tools for a
        // signed-in user — the same auth the approve/deny call sends; without
        // it the display request is anonymous and shows no tools.
        const infoHeaders = {};
        if (appParams.token) infoHeaders.Authorization = "Bearer " + appParams.token;
        const res = await fetch(
          `/api/apps/${appParams.appId}/mcp/consent-info?handle=${encodeURIComponent(ctx)}`,
          { credentials: "include", headers: infoHeaders },
        );
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError("This authorization link is invalid or has expired.");
          return;
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        // Gate on the server's auth result, NOT base44.auth.isAuthenticated():
        // the SDK check runs the bearer path, so a cookie-only session (platform
        // login/SSO, or a private app with a stale localStorage token) would read
        // as signed-out and redirect — even though /consent-info just
        // authenticated this same request via its cookie fallback. data.authenticated
        // keeps the redirect decision in agreement with what the server returned.
        if (!data.authenticated) {
          // The short handle rides back in returnTo; login_path is
          // owner-configured and validated server-side as a same-origin path.
          // Send from_url too: a custom-auth app coerced to platform auth (e.g.
          // public_without_login under workspace SSO) serves the platform login,
          // which honors from_url rather than returnTo. Rebuild the query from
          // `ctx` alone — never forward window.location.search raw: the platform
          // resume returns from_url verbatim, so crafted extras on the consent
          // link (app_base_url, access_token, …) would ride through the login
          // round-trip and app-params.js would persist them into the freshly
          // authenticated session.
          const returnTo =
            window.location.pathname + "?ctx=" + encodeURIComponent(ctx);
          const encoded = encodeURIComponent(returnTo);
          redirecting = true; // keep the spinner while the browser navigates
          window.location.href =
            (data.login_path || "/login") + "?returnTo=" + encoded + "&from_url=" + encoded;
          return;
        }
        setInfo(data);
      } catch (e) {
        setError("Could not load this authorization request. Please try again.");
      } finally {
        if (!redirecting) setChecking(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [ctx]);

  const respond = async (action) => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
      // Cookie-backed sessions carry no token; sending "Bearer null" would
      // shadow the valid cookie, so add the header only when a token exists.
      if (appParams.token) headers.Authorization = "Bearer " + appParams.token;
      const res = await fetch(`/api/apps/${appParams.appId}/mcp/authorize-grant`, {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "include",
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ ctx, action }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        // 401 = the session expired before the (single-use, still-unconsumed)
        // handle was spent; retrying the same controls re-sends the dead session
        // forever. Send the user back through login preserving `ctx` — the same
        // redirect the initial signed-out path uses — so they can return and
        // approve the still-valid handle.
        if (res.status === 401) {
          const returnTo = window.location.pathname + "?ctx=" + encodeURIComponent(ctx);
          const encoded = encodeURIComponent(returnTo);
          window.location.href =
            ((info && info.login_path) || "/login") + "?returnTo=" + encoded + "&from_url=" + encoded;
          return;
        }
        // These all come AFTER the single-use handle is atomically consumed
        // (409 tool set changed; 403 host/resource/app mismatch; 404 access
        // gone; 400 malformed/handle already used), so retrying can only 404.
        // Show a terminal reconnect state, not an impossible "try again".
        if ([400, 403, 404, 409].includes(res.status)) {
          let detail = "";
          try { detail = (await res.json()).detail; } catch (_) { /* keep default */ }
          setReconnect(detail || "This authorization can no longer be completed. Reconnect from your AI client to try again.");
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        throw new Error("Could not complete authorization. Please try again.");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      window.location.href = data.redirect_url;
      if (!/^https?:/i.test(data.redirect_url)) {
        // Custom-scheme redirect (native AI clients, e.g. cursor://): browsers
        // may block or not visibly navigate, so show a terminal state instead
        // of an eternal spinner.
        setDecided(action);
        setSubmitting(false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (checking) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Authorize access">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6 text-muted-foreground">
          <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          Loading…
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  const client = (info && info.client_name) || "An AI client";
  const appName = (info && info.app_name) || "this app";

  if (decided) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout
        icon={ShieldCheck}
        title={decided === "approve" ? "Access granted" : "Access denied"}
        subtitle={`You can return to ${client} and close this window.`}
      />
    );
  }

  // Terminal: the authorization request is no longer valid (tool set changed +
  // handle consumed). Retrying can't succeed, so show reconnect guidance with
  // no approve/deny controls.
  if (reconnect) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Reconnect required">
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {reconnect}
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  // No consent details means nothing trustworthy to approve: a failed
  // consent-info load (expired handle, rate limit, transient error) renders
  // the error alone, never the approve/deny controls.
  if (error && !info) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Authorize access">
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  const tools = Array.isArray(info.tools) ? info.tools : [];
  const { data, agents, actions } = groupTools(tools);

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={ShieldCheck}
      title="Authorize access"
      subtitle={`${client} wants to access ${appName} on your behalf`}
    >
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-3">
        {tools.length ? `${client} will be able to:` : "No tools requested"}
      </p>
      {tools.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-4 text-sm mb-6">
          {data.length > 0 && (
            <ToolSection title={`Data (${data.length})`}>
              {(showAllData ? data : data.slice(0, COLLAPSED_DATA_ROWS)).map(({ entity, operations }) => (
                <ToolRow key={entity} title={entity}>
                  <OperationSummary operations={operations} />
                </ToolRow>
              ))}
              {data.length > COLLAPSED_DATA_ROWS && (
                <li className="px-3 py-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="text-sm font-medium text-primary hover:underline"
                    onClick={() => setShowAllData((shown) => !shown)}
                  >
                    {showAllData ? "Show less" : `Show all ${data.length}`}
                  </button>
                </li>
              )}
            </ToolSection>
          )}
          {agents.length > 0 && (
            <ToolSection title="Agents">
              {agents.map((tool) => (
                <ToolRow key={tool.name} title={tool.agent ? humanize(tool.agent) : tool.title || tool.name}>
                  {tool.description}
                </ToolRow>
              ))}
            </ToolSection>
          )}
          {actions.length > 0 && (
            <ToolSection title="Actions">
              {actions.map((tool) => (
                <ToolRow key={tool.name} title={tool.title || tool.name}>
                  {tool.description}
                </ToolRow>
              ))}
            </ToolSection>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className="flex-1 h-12 font-medium"
          disabled={submitting}
          onClick={() => respond("deny")}
        >
          Deny
        </Button>
        <Button
          className="flex-1 h-12 font-medium"
          disabled={submitting}
          onClick={() => respond("approve")}
        >
          {submitting ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : null}
          Approve
        </Button>
      </div>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

````

````
    "episode_id",
    "order"
  ]
}
````
